steps.en: Review the license and provide the approved skill to an image-capable Codex host
steps.zh: 核对许可，将获准技能交给有图像工具的 Codex

steps.en: Upload your photo and invoke the travel-card skill
steps.zh: 上传照片，调用旅行卡片技能

steps.en: Select a recognizable anchor, six photo-derived motifs and three English keywords
steps.zh: 选辨识点、六个原图图案和三个英文关键词

steps.en: Ask the host image tool to redraw the scene and compose one memory card
steps.zh: 让宿主图像工具重绘场景，合成一张记忆卡

steps.en: Inspect, regenerate once if specified checks fail, then show the finished card
steps.zh: 看图，指定检查失败时重生成一次，再展示卡片

value.en: A personal photo becomes one illustrated keepsake without hand-arranging its matching sticker motifs
value.zh: 照片变成一张插画纪念卡，不用手工摆放呼应场景的贴纸
